definition.statistic: ND[s] = sum_{loads l not ADN} sum_t pd_l[s,t] * baseMVA * dt - sum_{generators g, gen_type in definitions.GEN_CURTAILLABLE_TYPES} sum_t pg_g[s,t] * baseMVA * dt, in MWh, dt = 24 h / num_instants; per network block (network, year, day); ADN loads = the TSO loads production zeroes after the checksum point (network.adn_load_exists / get_adn_load_idx for every DSO node); evaluation: float(np.sum(A[s])) * baseMVA * dt per array, accumulated in Python floats, loads by index then generators by index
definition.tie_rule: perm = sorted(range(n), key=lambda s: (ND[s], s)): ascending ND, exact ties -> lower original index first; new index k takes original index perm[k]; new_A = old_A[perm, :] for every operation array of the block (market arrays never permuted)
definition.coherence: each load / generator quantity is sampled with its own seed (network._update_network_with_operational_data), so a scenario of a network is the index s: the tuple of row s of all of that network block's operation arrays; the permutation moves that tuple as a unit
definition.array_sha: sha256 over b"<f8" + repr(shape).encode("ascii") + np.ascontiguousarray(A, dtype="<f8").tobytes() (the array as float64, C order)
